[[File:Dan Sokol DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Dan Sokol with [[Team Albany]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Dan Sokol''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd, 12 (+51), 6–2 at [[1999 Battle of Midway]] on 7 August 1999 with Revolver, according to Brian Terwilliger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d5">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ binghamton-new-york-8-7-99], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 12 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027001735/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-12-binghamton-new-york-8-7-99d5/ Internet Archive].</ref> He is the brother of [[Matt Sokol]], the 2000 World Champion.<ref name="tr-d1418" /><ref name="tr-d1417" /> He was a member of [[Team Albany]] and wore the team's yellow shirt with them at [[DecipherCon 1999]].<ref name="thu16">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/THU/thu16.html DecipherCon 1999 Thursday photo thu16], Decipher. Caption: "Team Albany - a Sokol, the Terwilligers and some other guy mug large for the digicam." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000524212725/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/THU/thu16.html Internet Archive]. Image: [http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/THU/large/thu16.jpg thu16.jpg], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020824150925im_/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/THU/large/thu16.jpg Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="msokol-pc">Matt Sokol, personal communication to Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026.</ref>
